understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shifted the selected piece by one grid cell, with coordinates changing by 3 pixels. CLICK was intended to select another piece using its pixel position. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed during movement, while walls and boundaries could block or behave differently depending on the object. The movement-blocked indicators were only hints, so actions had to be tested directly.

CLICK was intended to select another piece using its pixel position. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed during movement, while walls and boundaries could block or behave differently depending on the object. The movement-blocked indicators were only hints, so actions had to be tested directly.
